column3: BSB leaves out “and” at the start with the critical text; “its four winds” renders “the four winds of the earth”; “land” renders γῆς.
“The east” renders “[the] rising of [the] sun”; “power” is added.
“Land” renders γῆν; “sealed the foreheads of the servants” recasts “sealed the servants … on their foreheads.”
BSB follows the critical text with “were sealed” only at Judah.
BSB follows the critical text with no repeated “sealed.”
BSB follows the critical text with no repeated “sealed.”
BSB leaves out the final “sealed” (ἐσφραγισμένοι), which the critical text has after Benjamin.
“Too large to count” renders “which no one was able to number”; “They were wearing” and “holding” are added.
“Cried out” renders the present κράζουσιν (“they cry out”).
“Addressed me” renders ἀπεκρίθη (“answered”); “he asked” is added.
BSB follows the critical text with “made them white.” “Sir” renders “my lord”; “so he replied” renders “and he said to me.”
“Spread His tabernacle over them” renders “will tabernacle over them.”
“Will be their shepherd” renders “will shepherd them”; “springs of living water” renders “fountains of waters of life.”
